main_text.head: BOHEMICA.
Periodus I.
Explicatio.
main_text.p: Bohemorum conditor fuit Czechins[?], à quo Bohemi suâ hodieque linguâ Czechi appellantur. Cumq; initio Duces suos habuissent, Henricus IV Imperator Uladislaum A.C. 1086 Regem Bohemorum creavit: quem titulum per 180 annos intermissum Uladislaus alius A.C. 1159 concedente Friderico Barbarossa, recepit, & ad posteros continuâ serie transmisit.(a.) Bohemiæ.Regni Bohemici 1. Origo
main_text.head: Explicatio.
main_text.p: Premislaus, R ex Bohemiæ, qvod im[?]

page.notes: The left margin notes "(a.) Bohemiæ." and "Regni Bohemici 1. Origo" are placed at the first paragraph, where they stand in the margin. The word "Czechins" is split across a line break ("Czech-" / "chins") and the reading of the italic ending is doubtful. The final line is cut off at the page edge ("qvod im" with a faint ":" after it), so the paragraph continues on the next page. The small marks at the right edge of the text are printer's marks or show-through and are not transcribed.
